title: Rite of incubation in the giants' tombs

tellings.quote: those tombs, it's known to the archaeological community, were configured in such a way so that they could accommodate what's called the right of incubation

plain: The giants' tombs, ancient stone tombs on the Italian island of Sardinia, were built so that people could perform what is called the rite of incubation, a practice of sleeping in a sacred place to receive dreams or visions. That is what the researcher Tim Alberino tells Michels. He says the archaeological community already knows this, though he names no source, and he raises it as a clue to what the tombs were really for.
